name: sound-fx
title_zh: 文字落笔即出声，枪响雷鸣雨声都归你
tagline_zh: 写「篝火噼啪」就出柴火声，写「电梯门开」就出叮咚。不用找素材库、不用剪音频，一句话换一段能直接用的音效。
tagline_en: Type 'crackling fire' and get embers; type 'elevator ding' and get the chime. No library hunting, no audio.
desc_en: Use this skill whenever the user wants to generate sound effects, ambient audio, or short audio clips from a text description. Triggers include: any mention of 'sound effect', 'sfx', 'generate sound', 'make a sound', 'audio effect', 'ambient sound', 'foley', 'sound clip', 'noise', or requests to produce a specific sound (e.g. 'make a gunshot sound', 'generate thunder', 'create the sound of rain').
why_zh: 它把音效生成从「搜素材」变成「写描述」，触发词覆盖广，连 foley、noise 这种行话都认。
why_en: Turns sound hunting into text prompting—understands jargon like foley and noise, so you can drop a sound mid-flow without.
limit_zh: 只出短音频片段，不接长环境音轨或音乐。生成质量依赖底层模型，复杂拟音（如多层脚步声）可能失真。需联网调用，离线不可用。
limit_en: Short clips only—no long ambiences or music. Quality depends on the underlying model; complex foley (e.g., layered footsteps) may distort. Requires.
title_en: Text to sound: gunshots, thunder, rain at your command
